description: This file defines a React component 'PropertiesModal' for editing chart properties in Apache Superset, including form fields for name, description, owners, tags, cache settings, and certification info. It manages state, validation, data fetching, and submission logic for the modal dialog.

methods.name: PropertiesModal
methods.description: Main React component for the chart properties modal, handling form state, validation, data fetching, and submission.

methods.name: fetchChartProperties
methods.description: Fetches chart data including owners and tags from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: loadOptions
methods.description: Loads owner options asynchronously for the owner select input.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validation, and updates the chart via API.

methods.name: handleChangeTags
methods.description: Updates tags state based on user selection.
